author: Crystal M
text: 3 times he has told my husband he will come by for a quote and he has yet to show up. We sit around waiting on him and he never messages or calls. Wish he would just tell us he can't do it.

author: Curtis Drumm
text: Had an emergency need for a leak in the kitchen wall without hesitation John came and fixed the leak. Very professional and courteous and charged a very fair price. I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs.

author: Jeremy Glickman
text: Terrible service, I wish there was a 0 star. Made an appointment for him to come by 5 one day and he shows up at my business at 730 without calling or letting me know. I gave him a second chance the next morning, he said that he would be there in the AM and by 1230 still never showed up. When I asked when he would be there, he said by 5 that day too and when I told him that it was urgent, he said that I should find someone else to do the work and hung up. Terrible service

author: Marcel McElroy
text: I have used John Burke Plumbing 3 times now, and I'm as impressed now as I was the first time. They installed a gas line in our house for our gas dryer when we first moved in. They have since then replaced a flange, tower flush, fixed 2 backed up sink/shower drains, faucet repair and flap repair instead of saying that it needed to be replaced. They came within 24 hours even when we thought that it would be 48-72 hrs. . They are very knowledgeable, quick and pay great attention to the details. You never have to worry about them trying to get you to buy something that you don't need. We will be long time customers of theirs for sure. Thanks to the John Burke Plumbing team!
